roleContext.roleTitle: Delivery Project Coordinator, Retail Store Operations
roleContext.jobDescription: The store operations programme rolls out new point-of-sale hardware and shelf-label systems across a regional chain of about 140 stores. The Delivery Project Coordinator owns the end-to-end rollout plan for a wave of stores, holds the sign-off on store readiness, manages the field engineers' schedule, and is the single accountable person for the wave's delivery. The role sits in the programme office and works with regional operations, IT field services and the store managers.

requirements.text: Owns the end-to-end rollout plan for an assigned wave of stores, from scheduling through readiness sign-off, and is accountable for the wave's delivery.
Maintains the store-readiness tracker and the field-engineer schedule in the programme's planning tool.
Runs weekly readiness calls with regional operations and IT field services and records decisions and open items.
Escalates blockers to the programme lead with a recommended resolution and documents who decided what.
Produces the wave close-out report with lessons learned and hand-over conditions for store support.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Delivery Project Coordinator, Retail Store Operations

## Experience

- Coordinated the schedule for wave 3 of the point-of-sale rollout (26 stores) in the programme planning tool, keeping the readiness tracker current and re-sequencing store visits when field engineers were reassigned.
- Prepared the agenda and minutes for the weekly readiness call with regional operations and IT field services, and followed up on the open items list between calls.
- Raised scheduling and stock blockers to the programme lead with a suggested option; decisions on store priority and any date changes were taken by the programme lead, and readiness sign-off for each store was given by the regional operations manager.
- Drafted the wave 3 close-out report from the tracker and the call minutes, including lessons learned on shelf-label stock and the hand-over checklist for store support.
- Responsibilities included tracker maintenance, meeting coordination, blocker escalation and close-out documentation as a member of the programme office during the wave 3 rollout.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the wave 3 readiness tracker export (store, visit date, engineer, readiness status, sign-off name, open items) and the close-out report draft with tracked changes from the programme lead.
